values.Example: Hundreds of families live in this tower block.
values.ExampleTranslation: Hàng trăm gia đình sống trong tòa chung cư cao tầng này.
values.MeaningEn: a very tall building with many flats
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"Hundreds of families live in this tower block.","vi":"H\u00E0ng tr\u0103m gia \u0111\u00ECnh s\u1ED1ng trong t\u00F2a chung c\u01B0 cao t\u1EA7ng n\u00E0y."},{"text":"The tower block has two lifts.","vi":"T\u00F2a chung c\u01B0 cao t\u1EA7ng c\u00F3 hai thang m\u00E1y."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"live in a tower block","vi":"s\u1ED1ng \u1EDF chung c\u01B0 cao t\u1EA7ng"},{"text":"old tower block","vi":"chung c\u01B0 cao t\u1EA7ng c\u0169"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: Someone is ringing the doorbell.
values.ExampleTranslation: Có ai đó đang bấm chuông cửa.
values.MeaningEn: a button by a door that makes a sound inside
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"Someone is ringing the doorbell.","vi":"C\u00F3 ai \u0111\u00F3 \u0111ang b\u1EA5m chu\u00F4ng c\u1EEDa."},{"text":"The doorbell rang while we were eating.","vi":"Chu\u00F4ng c\u1EEDa reo khi ch\u00FAng t\u00F4i \u0111ang \u0103n."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"ring the doorbell","vi":"b\u1EA5m chu\u00F4ng c\u1EEDa"},{"text":"press the doorbell","vi":"nh\u1EA5n chu\u00F4ng c\u1EEDa"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: Stop when the traffic light is red.
values.ExampleTranslation: Hãy dừng lại khi đèn giao thông màu đỏ.
values.MeaningEn: a set of red, yellow and green lights that control vehicles
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"Stop when the traffic light is red.","vi":"H\u00E3y d\u1EEBng l\u1EA1i khi \u0111\u00E8n giao th\u00F4ng m\u00E0u \u0111\u1ECF."},{"text":"The traffic light turned green.","vi":"\u0110\u00E8n giao th\u00F4ng chuy\u1EC3n sang m\u00E0u xanh."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"wait at a traffic light","vi":"ch\u1EDD \u1EDF \u0111\u00E8n giao th\u00F4ng"},{"text":"red traffic light","vi":"\u0111\u00E8n giao th\u00F4ng \u0111\u1ECF"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: We were stuck in a traffic jam for an hour.
values.ExampleTranslation: Chúng tôi bị kẹt xe cả tiếng đồng hồ.
values.MeaningEn: a long line of vehicles that cannot move quickly
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"We were stuck in a traffic jam for an hour.","vi":"Ch\u00FAng t\u00F4i b\u1ECB k\u1EB9t xe c\u1EA3 ti\u1EBFng \u0111\u1ED3ng h\u1ED3."},{"text":"The traffic jam was caused by an accident.","vi":"V\u1EE5 k\u1EB9t xe do m\u1ED9t tai n\u1EA1n g\u00E2y ra."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"get stuck in a traffic jam","vi":"b\u1ECB k\u1EB9t xe"},{"text":"heavy traffic jam","vi":"k\u1EB9t xe nghi\u00EAm tr\u1ECDng"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The rent for this flat is very high.
values.ExampleTranslation: Tiền thuê căn hộ này rất cao.
values.MeaningEn: money you pay regularly to live in a place you do not own
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The rent for this flat is very high.","vi":"Ti\u1EC1n thu\u00EA c\u0103n h\u1ED9 n\u00E0y r\u1EA5t cao."},{"text":"I pay the rent on the first of every month.","vi":"T\u00F4i tr\u1EA3 ti\u1EC1n thu\u00EA nh\u00E0 v\u00E0o ng\u00E0y \u0111\u1EA7u m\u1ED7i th\u00E1ng."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"pay the rent","vi":"tr\u1EA3 ti\u1EC1n thu\u00EA"},{"text":"monthly rent","vi":"ti\u1EC1n thu\u00EA h\u1EB1ng th\u00E1ng"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: Take the second exit at the roundabout.
values.ExampleTranslation: Hãy đi lối ra thứ hai ở vòng xoay.
values.MeaningEn: a circular place where roads meet and traffic goes round
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"Take the second exit at the roundabout.","vi":"H\u00E3y \u0111i l\u1ED1i ra th\u1EE9 hai \u1EDF v\u00F2ng xoay."},{"text":"There is a new roundabout near my school.","vi":"C\u00F3 m\u1ED9t v\u00F2ng xoay m\u1EDBi g\u1EA7n tr\u01B0\u1EDDng t\u00F4i."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"take the second exit","vi":"\u0111i l\u1ED1i ra th\u1EE9 hai"},{"text":"busy roundabout","vi":"v\u00F2ng xoay \u0111\u00F4ng xe"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: My grandparents live in a small stone cottage.
values.ExampleTranslation: Ông bà tôi sống trong một căn nhà đá nhỏ ở quê.
values.MeaningEn: a small house in the countryside
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"My grandparents live in a small stone cottage.","vi":"\u00D4ng b\u00E0 t\u00F4i s\u1ED1ng trong m\u1ED9t c\u0103n nh\u00E0 \u0111\u00E1 nh\u1ECF \u1EDF qu\u00EA."},{"text":"The cottage has a red door.","vi":"C\u0103n nh\u00E0 nh\u1ECF c\u00F3 c\u00E1nh c\u1EEDa m\u00E0u \u0111\u1ECF."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"country cottage","vi":"nh\u00E0 nh\u1ECF \u1EDF v\u00F9ng qu\u00EA"},{"text":"thatched cottage","vi":"nh\u00E0 m\u00E1i tranh"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: Our landlord lives on the ground floor.
values.ExampleTranslation: Chủ nhà của chúng tôi sống ở tầng trệt.
values.MeaningEn: a person who owns a house and rents it to others
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"Our landlord lives on the ground floor.","vi":"Ch\u1EE7 nh\u00E0 c\u1EE7a ch\u00FAng t\u00F4i s\u1ED1ng \u1EDF t\u1EA7ng tr\u1EC7t."},{"text":"I called the landlord about the broken heater.","vi":"T\u00F4i g\u1ECDi cho ch\u1EE7 nh\u00E0 v\u1EC1 chi\u1EBFc l\u00F2 s\u01B0\u1EDFi b\u1ECB h\u1ECFng."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"meet the landlord","vi":"g\u1EB7p ch\u1EE7 nh\u00E0"},{"text":"kind landlord","vi":"ch\u1EE7 nh\u00E0 t\u1ED1t b\u1EE5ng"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The street lamps come on at six o'clock.
values.ExampleTranslation: Đèn đường bật lên lúc sáu giờ.
values.MeaningEn: a tall light beside a road
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The street lamps come on at six o\u0027clock.","vi":"\u0110\u00E8n \u0111\u01B0\u1EDDng b\u1EADt l\u00EAn l\u00FAc s\u00E1u gi\u1EDD."},{"text":"An old street lamp stood at the corner.","vi":"M\u1ED9t chi\u1EBFc \u0111\u00E8n \u0111\u01B0\u1EDDng c\u0169 \u0111\u1EE9ng \u1EDF g\u00F3c ph\u1ED1."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"light a street lamp","vi":"th\u1EAFp \u0111\u00E8n \u0111\u01B0\u1EDDng"},{"text":"old street lamp","vi":"\u0111\u00E8n \u0111\u01B0\u1EDDng c\u0169"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The city has more than fifty skyscrapers.
values.ExampleTranslation: Thành phố có hơn năm mươi tòa nhà chọc trời.
values.MeaningEn: a very tall building in a city
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The city has more than fifty skyscrapers.","vi":"Th\u00E0nh ph\u1ED1 c\u00F3 h\u01A1n n\u0103m m\u01B0\u01A1i t\u00F2a nh\u00E0 ch\u1ECDc tr\u1EDDi."},{"text":"We had dinner on the top floor of a skyscraper.","vi":"Ch\u00FAng t\u00F4i \u0103n t\u1ED1i \u1EDF t\u1EA7ng cao nh\u1EA5t c\u1EE7a m\u1ED9t t\u00F2a nh\u00E0 ch\u1ECDc tr\u1EDDi."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"tall skyscraper","vi":"t\u00F2a nh\u00E0 ch\u1ECDc tr\u1EDDi cao"},{"text":"glass skyscraper","vi":"t\u00F2a nh\u00E0 ch\u1ECDc tr\u1EDDi b\u1EB1ng k\u00EDnh"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: It is a safe and friendly neighbourhood.
values.ExampleTranslation: Đây là một khu phố an toàn và thân thiện.
values.MeaningEn: a part of a town where people live
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"It is a safe and friendly neighbourhood.","vi":"\u0110\u00E2y l\u00E0 m\u1ED9t khu ph\u1ED1 an to\u00E0n v\u00E0 th\u00E2n thi\u1EC7n."},{"text":"There are two parks in my neighbourhood.","vi":"C\u00F3 hai c\u00F4ng vi\u00EAn trong khu ph\u1ED1 c\u1EE7a t\u00F4i."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"quiet neighbourhood","vi":"khu ph\u1ED1 y\u00EAn t\u0129nh"},{"text":"in the neighbourhood","vi":"trong khu ph\u1ED1"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: Always use the zebra crossing near the school.
values.ExampleTranslation: Hãy luôn dùng vạch qua đường gần trường học.
values.MeaningEn: black and white stripes where people can cross the road
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"Always use the zebra crossing near the school.","vi":"H\u00E3y lu\u00F4n d\u00F9ng v\u1EA1ch qua \u0111\u01B0\u1EDDng g\u1EA7n tr\u01B0\u1EDDng h\u1ECDc."},{"text":"The car stopped at the zebra crossing.","vi":"Chi\u1EBFc xe d\u1EEBng l\u1EA1i \u1EDF v\u1EA1ch qua \u0111\u01B0\u1EDDng."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"cross at the zebra crossing","vi":"qua \u0111\u01B0\u1EDDng \u1EDF v\u1EA1ch d\u00E0nh cho ng\u01B0\u1EDDi \u0111i b\u1ED9"},{"text":"busy zebra crossing","vi":"v\u1EA1ch qua \u0111\u01B0\u1EDDng \u0111\u00F4ng \u0111\u00FAc"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: I left my house key at the office.
values.ExampleTranslation: Tôi để quên chìa khóa nhà ở văn phòng.
values.MeaningEn: a small metal tool that opens or locks a door
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"I left my house key at the office.","vi":"T\u00F4i \u0111\u1EC3 qu\u00EAn ch\u00ECa kh\u00F3a nh\u00E0 \u1EDF v\u0103n ph\u00F2ng."},{"text":"Do you have the key to the garage?","vi":"B\u1EA1n c\u00F3 ch\u00ECa kh\u00F3a nh\u00E0 \u0111\u1EC3 xe kh\u00F4ng?"}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"house key","vi":"ch\u00ECa kh\u00F3a nh\u00E0"},{"text":"turn the key","vi":"xoay ch\u00ECa kh\u00F3a"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: We live in a quiet suburb.
values.ExampleTranslation: Chúng tôi sống ở một vùng ngoại ô yên tĩnh.
values.MeaningEn: an area of houses at the edge of a city
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"We live in a quiet suburb.","vi":"Ch\u00FAng t\u00F4i s\u1ED1ng \u1EDF m\u1ED9t v\u00F9ng ngo\u1EA1i \u00F4 y\u00EAn t\u0129nh."},{"text":"The suburb is twenty minutes from the centre.","vi":"V\u00F9ng ngo\u1EA1i \u00F4 c\u00E1ch trung t\u00E2m hai m\u01B0\u01A1i ph\u00FAt."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"quiet suburb","vi":"v\u00F9ng ngo\u1EA1i \u00F4 y\u00EAn t\u0129nh"},{"text":"live in the suburbs","vi":"s\u1ED1ng \u1EDF ngo\u1EA1i \u00F4"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: Turn left at the crossroads.
values.ExampleTranslation: Hãy rẽ trái ở ngã tư.
values.MeaningEn: a place where two roads cross each other
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"Turn left at the crossroads.","vi":"H\u00E3y r\u1EBD tr\u00E1i \u1EDF ng\u00E3 t\u01B0."},{"text":"There is a petrol station at the crossroads.","vi":"C\u00F3 m\u1ED9t tr\u1EA1m x\u0103ng \u1EDF ng\u00E3 t\u01B0."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"at the crossroads","vi":"\u1EDF ng\u00E3 t\u01B0"},{"text":"busy crossroads","vi":"ng\u00E3 t\u01B0 \u0111\u00F4ng \u0111\u00FAc"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The monument stands in the middle of the square.
values.ExampleTranslation: Đài tưởng niệm đứng ở giữa quảng trường.
values.MeaningEn: a large structure built to remember a person or event
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The monument stands in the middle of the square.","vi":"\u0110\u00E0i t\u01B0\u1EDFng ni\u1EC7m \u0111\u1EE9ng \u1EDF gi\u1EEFa qu\u1EA3ng tr\u01B0\u1EDDng."},{"text":"Thousands of tourists visit the monument each year.","vi":"H\u00E0ng ngh\u00ECn du kh\u00E1ch \u0111\u1EBFn th\u0103m \u0111\u00E0i t\u01B0\u1EDFng ni\u1EC7m m\u1ED7i n\u0103m."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"national monument","vi":"\u0111\u00E0i t\u01B0\u1EDFng ni\u1EC7m qu\u1ED1c gia"},{"text":"visit a monument","vi":"th\u0103m \u0111\u00E0i t\u01B0\u1EDFng ni\u1EC7m"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: I wait at the bus stop every morning.
values.ExampleTranslation: Sáng nào tôi cũng đợi ở trạm xe buýt.
values.MeaningEn: a place where buses stop for passengers
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"I wait at the bus stop every morning.","vi":"S\u00E1ng n\u00E0o t\u00F4i c\u0169ng \u0111\u1EE3i \u1EDF tr\u1EA1m xe bu\u00FDt."},{"text":"The bus stop is just across the street.","vi":"Tr\u1EA1m xe bu\u00FDt \u1EDF ngay b\u00EAn kia \u0111\u01B0\u1EDDng."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"wait at the bus stop","vi":"\u0111\u1EE3i \u1EDF tr\u1EA1m xe bu\u00FDt"},{"text":"nearest bus stop","vi":"tr\u1EA1m xe bu\u00FDt g\u1EA7n nh\u1EA5t"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The playground equipment was repainted last summer.
values.ExampleTranslation: Thiết bị sân chơi được sơn lại vào mùa hè năm ngoái.
values.MeaningEn: slides and swings for children to play on
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The playground equipment was repainted last summer.","vi":"Thi\u1EBFt b\u1ECB s\u00E2n ch\u01A1i \u0111\u01B0\u1EE3c s\u01A1n l\u1EA1i v\u00E0o m\u00F9a h\u00E8 n\u0103m ngo\u00E1i."},{"text":"Safe playground equipment is important.","vi":"Thi\u1EBFt b\u1ECB s\u00E2n ch\u01A1i an to\u00E0n r\u1EA5t quan tr\u1ECDng."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"new playground equipment","vi":"thi\u1EBFt b\u1ECB s\u00E2n ch\u01A1i m\u1EDBi"},{"text":"playground equipment for kids","vi":"thi\u1EBFt b\u1ECB s\u00E2n ch\u01A1i cho tr\u1EBB"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: Please close the garden gate behind you.
values.ExampleTranslation: Làm ơn đóng cổng vườn lại sau lưng bạn.
values.MeaningEn: a small door in a fence or wall around a garden
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"Please close the garden gate behind you.","vi":"L\u00E0m \u01A1n \u0111\u00F3ng c\u1ED5ng v\u01B0\u1EDDn l\u1EA1i sau l\u01B0ng b\u1EA1n."},{"text":"The dog waited at the garden gate.","vi":"Con ch\u00F3 \u0111\u1EE3i \u1EDF c\u1ED5ng v\u01B0\u1EDDn."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"open the garden gate","vi":"m\u1EDF c\u1ED5ng v\u01B0\u1EDDn"},{"text":"wooden garden gate","vi":"c\u1ED5ng v\u01B0\u1EDDn b\u1EB1ng g\u1ED7"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: Children played near the fountain in the square.
values.ExampleTranslation: Trẻ em chơi gần đài phun nước ở quảng trường.
values.MeaningEn: a structure that sends water up into the air
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"Children played near the fountain in the square.","vi":"Tr\u1EBB em ch\u01A1i g\u1EA7n \u0111\u00E0i phun n\u01B0\u1EDBc \u1EDF qu\u1EA3ng tr\u01B0\u1EDDng."},{"text":"There is a stone fountain in the park.","vi":"C\u00F3 m\u1ED9t \u0111\u00E0i phun n\u01B0\u1EDBc b\u1EB1ng \u0111\u00E1 trong c\u00F4ng vi\u00EAn."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"stone fountain","vi":"\u0111\u00E0i phun n\u01B0\u1EDBc b\u1EB1ng \u0111\u00E1"},{"text":"fountain in the square","vi":"\u0111\u00E0i phun n\u01B0\u1EDBc \u1EDF qu\u1EA3ng tr\u01B0\u1EDDng"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: I left my car in the parking lot behind the mall.
values.ExampleTranslation: Tôi để xe ở bãi đỗ phía sau trung tâm thương mại.
values.MeaningEn: an open area where people leave their cars
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"I left my car in the parking lot behind the mall.","vi":"T\u00F4i \u0111\u1EC3 xe \u1EDF b\u00E3i \u0111\u1ED7 ph\u00EDa sau trung t\u00E2m th\u01B0\u01A1ng m\u1EA1i."},{"text":"The parking lot is full on weekends.","vi":"B\u00E3i \u0111\u1ED7 xe lu\u00F4n \u0111\u1EA7y v\u00E0o cu\u1ED1i tu\u1EA7n."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"find a parking lot","vi":"t\u00ECm b\u00E3i \u0111\u1ED7 xe"},{"text":"underground parking lot","vi":"b\u00E3i \u0111\u1ED7 xe ng\u1EA7m"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: They rented a villa near the sea.
values.ExampleTranslation: Họ thuê một căn biệt thự gần biển.
values.MeaningEn: a large house, often with a garden, in a warm place
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"They rented a villa near the sea.","vi":"H\u1ECD thu\u00EA m\u1ED9t c\u0103n bi\u1EC7t th\u1EF1 g\u1EA7n bi\u1EC3n."},{"text":"The villa has a swimming pool.","vi":"C\u0103n bi\u1EC7t th\u1EF1 c\u00F3 m\u1ED9t b\u1EC3 b\u01A1i."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"rent a villa","vi":"thu\u00EA bi\u1EC7t th\u1EF1"},{"text":"holiday villa","vi":"bi\u1EC7t th\u1EF1 ngh\u1EC9 d\u01B0\u1EE1ng"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The postman put a letter in the mailbox.
values.ExampleTranslation: Người đưa thư bỏ một lá thư vào hộp thư.
values.MeaningEn: a box outside a house where letters are delivered
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The postman put a letter in the mailbox.","vi":"Ng\u01B0\u1EDDi \u0111\u01B0a th\u01B0 b\u1ECF m\u1ED9t l\u00E1 th\u01B0 v\u00E0o h\u1ED9p th\u01B0."},{"text":"Our mailbox is by the front gate.","vi":"H\u1ED9p th\u01B0 c\u1EE7a ch\u00FAng t\u00F4i \u1EDF c\u1EA1nh c\u1ED5ng tr\u01B0\u1EDBc."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"check the mailbox","vi":"ki\u1EC3m tra h\u1ED9p th\u01B0"},{"text":"red mailbox","vi":"h\u1ED9p th\u01B0 m\u00E0u \u0111\u1ECF"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: People meet in the town square on weekends.
values.ExampleTranslation: Mọi người gặp nhau ở quảng trường thị trấn vào cuối tuần.
values.MeaningEn: an open area in the centre of a town
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"People meet in the town square on weekends.","vi":"M\u1ECDi ng\u01B0\u1EDDi g\u1EB7p nhau \u1EDF qu\u1EA3ng tr\u01B0\u1EDDng th\u1ECB tr\u1EA5n v\u00E0o cu\u1ED1i tu\u1EA7n."},{"text":"The market is held in the town square.","vi":"Phi\u00EAn ch\u1EE3 \u0111\u01B0\u1EE3c t\u1ED5 ch\u1EE9c \u1EDF qu\u1EA3ng tr\u01B0\u1EDDng th\u1ECB tr\u1EA5n."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"busy town square","vi":"qu\u1EA3ng tr\u01B0\u1EDDng th\u1ECB tr\u1EA5n nh\u1ED9n nh\u1ECBp"},{"text":"meet in the town square","vi":"g\u1EB7p nhau \u1EDF qu\u1EA3ng tr\u01B0\u1EDDng"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: Please walk on the pavement, not on the road.
values.ExampleTranslation: Hãy đi trên vỉa hè, đừng đi dưới lòng đường.
values.MeaningEn: the path at the side of a road for people on foot
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"Please walk on the pavement, not on the road.","vi":"H\u00E3y \u0111i tr\u00EAn v\u1EC9a h\u00E8, \u0111\u1EEBng \u0111i d\u01B0\u1EDBi l\u00F2ng \u0111\u01B0\u1EDDng."},{"text":"The pavement was wet after the rain.","vi":"V\u1EC9a h\u00E8 \u01B0\u1EDBt sau c\u01A1n m\u01B0a."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"wide pavement","vi":"v\u1EC9a h\u00E8 r\u1ED9ng"},{"text":"walk along the pavement","vi":"\u0111i d\u1ECDc v\u1EC9a h\u00E8"}],"wordFamily":[]}
